_readme: Businesses at Kesteven Business Centre for centre.tagsleaford.com. EDIT THIS FILE ONLY - tenants.html and the homepage 'Businesses at the centre' strip render it automatically. status: visible | hidden (hidden entries are NEVER rendered - flip to visible once the business has OK'd it). featured: true = large photo card with full write-up on tenants.html AND a card on the homepage; false = compact card (name, sector, one line, link) on tenants.html only. Order = display order. Optional fields: summary (one-liner for cards), phone, email, hours, highlights[], range[{heading,items[]}], applications[], imageAlt/imageWidth/imageHeight, logoWidth/logoHeight. Only put an email on a card if the business has published it themselves. After editing, commit to main; GitHub Pages redeploys in ~1 min.

tenants.name: K2B Ltd
tenants.tagline: Innovation to Procurement — Ideas to Reality
tenants.summary: A specialist supplier of natural, clean-label food and drink ingredients — agent for worldwide manufacturers for over 20 years, ISO 9001:2015 certified.
tenants.description: K2B Ltd acts as an agent for worldwide manufacturers in the food and drinks industry. In business for over 20 years, K2B has built a reputation for reliability, customer service and technical back-up, and is committed to supplying quality-assured ingredients at competitive prices. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified and all of its manufacturing partners hold GFSI (Global Food Safety Initiative) certification. All products are made from natural ingredients and are GMO-free.
